title: Product list (current codes), Valdena sales.products
summary: Static internal product master of about 64 rows giving the current product_code, product_name and category for the Valdena Gelato shop's products. It holds only codes in force after the 2024-04-01 code change, so it cannot map pre-2024 codes to current ones. The wiki states that no mapping table exists and that old and new codes can only be matched by name, where some names are not unique.

schema.notes: Column list from catalog entry only; no sample was read because this is a warehouse_sql source, not a file.

spatial.code_system: free-text product names and internal codes
spatial.notes: Catalog gives no geography field. Scope is the Valdena shop's own product range, assumed to be Italy-based; not stated in the sources read.

licence.name: internal

documentation_excerpts: Current product codes, names and categories. (catalog description)

quality_notes: Does not meet N2 on its own: it lists only current codes, and the wiki (product_codes_2024, 2024-04-02) says no mapping table exists.
Name matching for old-to-new code bridging is unreliable: wiki says some product names are not unique.

Freshness: catalog says refresh cadence 'on change' with last_refreshed 2025-03-31. The catalog was exported 2026-10-14, so the table is about 19 months old against the as_of date of 2026-10-15. Any product changes after 2025-03-31 (including ones affecting the 2025-06 to 2026-03 recent window) are not reflected. The candidate's note that the refresh was 'despite' the on-change cadence is not supported: a refresh after the 2024 change is consistent with 'on change'.

Catalog and wiki agree on the existence of the 2024 change and the absence of a mapping table. The wiki does not give the number of old codes ending in 'L' or confirm the 2024-04-01 date beyond its own text.
No sample was read, because the source is a warehouse_sql table and not a file. Row count of about 64 is catalog-declared and unverified.
